title: Remove Field At
prompt: A React dynamic form removes one field by index. Write a helper that returns a new array without the item at that index. If the index is out of range, return a copy of the original array.

explanation.beginner:
Example: removeFieldAt(["a","b","c"], 1) produces ["a","c"]. The result must follow this precise rule: A React dynamic form removes one field by index. Write a helper that returns a new array without the item at that index. If the index is out of range, return a copy of the original array. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “handles first item”: input [["a","b"],0] produces ["b"]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
